# ContextMenu

Right-click menu for tracks, albums and playlists.

`Icyre.ContextMenu` · Overlays

## Use

```jsx
<Icyre.ContextMenu items={…}>…</Icyre.ContextMenu>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Icyre.ContextMenu" items="{{…}}">…</x-import>
```
